compatibility.current_wire: frankenmemory.v2 schema.json remains strict and unchanged
compatibility.entity_ref: existing entity_ref retains its current meaning and shape
compatibility.knowledge_ref: distinct future negotiated variant; old peers must reject as unsupported rather than reinterpret entity_ref
compatibility.absence: unknown or omitted is distinct from explicit false, zero, empty string, and typed null
compatibility.storage: fixtures do not create a database, change schema, register jobs, or activate forgetting

contracts.name: SourcePart
contracts.authority: host conversation archive owns canonical owner/chat/actor/message/part/revision identity; workspace/project and content hash are validated metadata; source locator is not a replacement for identity; ACP revisions are distinct
invariants: hydrate authorized exact current revision only; historical hydration is unsupported
validate content hash, workspace, removal and optional span bounds
require committed archive part and verified completed-turn marker for eligible automatic capture
changed revision is stale; missing, deleted or inaccessible source fails closed
no raw-copy fallback; archive append failure cannot produce durable success

contracts.name: MemoryReference
contracts.authority: existing V2 block identity and immutable revision with owner/scope visibility
invariants: cross-owner references rejected
exact revision does not silently become current head
entity_ref is not a knowledge_ref

contracts.name: Proposal
contracts.authority: V2 revision and current human-protection authority; proposals are not accepted values
invariants: stale expected revision cannot overwrite
legacy unknown is not inferred manual
manual falsy values remain explicit
states are pending approved rejected or superseded
same scoped idempotency key cannot silently change payload

contracts.name: Observation
contracts.authority: S06 append-only event evidence tied to exact source and memory revision
invariants: found is not admitted or helpful
deduplicate retry by scoped identity
pending turn evidence is bounded and not durable success
deduplication includes owner workspace producer idempotency kind and exact memory revision
same-key different payload hash conflicts
admission references found event where available; helped references admission

contracts.name: Job
contracts.authority: existing V2 jobs and fenced attempts; source and policy revalidated before effects
invariants: busy or unknown does not authorize dispatch
cancellation is not success
retry respects idempotency and persisted budget
connection_id is backend contention key; model_route_id retains exact entitlement route
separate global one-call cap remains required

contracts.name: RatingTarget
contracts.authority: canonical chat message/section or whole-chat snapshot revision and owner access
invariants: unrated differs from zero
only 0..5 half steps accepted
Unicode and multi-message boundaries remain exact
inaccessible or stale targets do not rebind
